_comment: ALLOWLIST, not a denylist - fail-closed by design (see
full rationale). A parameter not named here is unsafe-by-default.
EnvironmentName            - identity of the stack itself.
LambdaRuntime              - changing the Node runtime without a real
rebuild against it is not a shortcut to allow.
LambdaCodeS3Bucket/Key     - LambdaCodeS3Key is a freshly timestamped
key only a real deploy's upload produces.
FollowupTableName          - PHYSICAL name of the DynamoDB table this
template creates; changing it makes CFN
